components.name: Button
components.notes: Pilot approved by the user on 2026-08-14 after rendered verification at 1440px and 390px. Canonical variants are primary, secondary, outline, quiet, danger, success, warning, success-light and warning-light; canonical sizes are xs, sm, md, and lg. The default/ghost/destructive and default/icon-* names remain temporary compatibility aliases for existing consumers, while link remains a transitional capability pending the Link family. Product adoption covers the CMP Dashboard recovery slice, unavailable form-route navigation, client data-grid Columns/New actions, and the client/engagement preview actions. A follow-up Patch keeps compact compound Button content, including data-grid header labels and sort icons, inline. CMP notification cards now wrap their richer title, body, and metadata regions in one domain-owned vertical container instead of relying on the Button label's internal layout. Product evidence covers pointer and keyboard interaction at 1440px and 390px. Vivid success/warning fills preserve the customer's mandatory green P / orange R signoff convention; graphic colors and readable foregrounds are independently tested. Tinted variants remain available. See ui-bright-harmony-review.md, /specimens/Color and /specimens/Button. Product-wide design-system approval remains proposed.

components.name: SmartFormPdfWorkpaper
components.notes: Approved by the user on 2026-09-04 after rendered review. The EasyPaper 0.2.2 adapter removes default visible heading numbering, replaces Windows-only fonts with deployable Noto/Liberation families, maps every legal SmartForm AST node to formal content and three-line tables, and preserves native review annotations. The showroom covers Chinese and English documents, matched/otherwise/unanswered conditional states, rich text, seven field kinds, repeated table headers, and complete, pending, and multi-person sign-off groups. Signatories appear once in the author position; muted print text uses a darker neutral range for legibility. Product adoption covers live preview, project archives, and project-file export snapshots.

components.name: PdfTemplateDesigner
components.notes: The user approved WYSIWYG product adoption on 2026-08-29 for open-source font family, point size, bold, italic, underline, text color, background color, and alignment. The Office-style single-row Ribbon and collapsed-by-default inspector were explicitly approved and migrated to EMP. The Ribbon has functional history, clipboard, insertion, font, alignment, page, and operations groups; Noto and Liberation are the only selectable font families. Field formatting and alignment apply to both the design prompt and entered value and persist into exports. The insertion group exposes single-line text, multiline text, static text, radio, number, and date; checkbox and dropdown remain backward-compatible only. A unified cascaded Default fill control supports editable snapshots from base information, the confirmation information library, type-safe custom values, and the current date. Static text never creates a field value. The ephemeral author preview suppresses defaults and never saves preview input. Radio fields use a neutral single-select dropdown that preserves exact field geometry; only enabled status uses the semantic success badge. Ribbon groups use visible slate separators. The workbench preserves proportional glyphs outside the non-uniform SVG geometry layer and exposes drawing, idle, and selected field frames. The pdfme 6.1 adapter remains experimental pending final EMP visual verification.
